content: If you love a flower, don't pick it up. Because if you pick it up it dies and it ceases to be what you love. So if you love a flower, let it be. Love is not about possession. Love is about appreciation.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Meditation: The First and Last Freedom
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Reminding yourself of your mortality is not morbid; it is the most clarifying lens available to human consciousness. When you remember that your days are strictly numbered, petty resentments and trivial anxieties evaporate.

In Osho's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Death gives urgency and sweetness to every ordinary afternoon. Because this day will never come again, the way you spend your attention right now is of monumental significance.
reflectionPrompt: Who in your life needs your unconditional support or appreciation today without any transaction?
